Renaissance Group Llc increased its stake in Cisco Systems Inc (CSCO) by 1280.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Renaissance Group Llc bought 830,108 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.71% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 894,948 shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $34.28M, up from 64,840 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Renaissance Group Llc who had been investing in Cisco Systems Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $207.44 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 1.35% or $0.59 during the last trading session, reaching $43.06. About 8.29M shares traded. Cisco Systems, Inc. (NASDAQ:CSCO) has risen 25.57% since May 23, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.02% the S&P500.
Renaissance Group Llc, which manages about $2.96B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Controladora Vuela Compania E (NYSE:VLRS) by 841,225 shares to 238,080 shares, valued at $1.91M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in T Rowe Price Group Inc (NASDAQ:TROW) by 60,885 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 337,006 shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
